abstract.text: TrustPin SSL certificate pinning SDK for Apple platforms.

inlineContent.text: TrustPin provides SSL certificate pinning functionality to prevent
man-in-the-middle (MITM) attacks by validating server certificates against
pre-configured public-key pins. The library supports iOS, macOS, tvOS,
watchOS, and visionOS with a unified async/await API.
For most applications a single, shared pinning context is sufficient. Use
